entities.name: Modern Claims Platform
entities.description: A modern cloud-based platform that gradually replaces a 30-year-old mainframe claims system through a hybrid architecture, ensuring seamless incremental migration of claim types without service disruption.

entities.name: Customers and Brokers
entities.description: External users who interact with the system to submit and manage claims.

entities.name: Claims Adjusters
entities.description: Internal staff who review, process, and manage claims within the system.

entities.name: Operations and Support Staff
entities.description: Staff responsible for monitoring system operations and providing user support.

entities.name: Finance and Accounting
entities.description: Internal department responsible for financial reconciliation and reporting.

entities.name: Legacy Mainframe System
entities.description: On-Premises COBOL/DB2 mainframe system acting as the system of record.

entities.name: Enterprise Identity Provider
entities.description: Active Directory / Entra ID providing Single Sign-On (OIDC).

interfaces.description: Interacts with the platform to manage claims
Receives financial feeds and reconciliation data

interfaces.protocol: Encrypted TCP/MQ with mTLS via Enterprise Service Bus

naming_conventions: External systems are named using their functional role and identity (e.g., 'Legacy Mainframe System', 'Enterprise Identity Provider').
Actor groups and departments are named in plural or collective forms (e.g., 'Customers and Brokers', 'Claims Adjusters', 'Finance and Accounting').
